name: LAMA3
summary: LAMA3 (JEB), junctional epidermolysis bullosa, the American Saddlebred variant - a recessive lethal with the best-measured frequency in the mod: a random foal-crop sample found 9 carriers in 175. Separate from the draft breeds' LAMC2 form.

phenotypes.name: Wild type
phenotypes.description: Two working copies. Nothing is wrong and nothing is passed on.

phenotypes.name: LAMA3 carrier
phenotypes.description: One copy of jeb. The horse is completely normal and there is no way to see it - but half its foals inherit the copy, and two carriers bred together are the only way junctional epidermolysis bullosa (lama3) appears.

phenotypes.name: Junctional epidermolysis bullosa (LAMA3)
phenotypes.description: A missing piece of LAMA3, and the skin has nothing to hold on to. The hoof capsules come away and the skin splits at every pressure point. The foal does not survive.
